title: The Little Skiff and the Slow Tide
youtube_title: The Little Skiff and the Slow Tide | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Patience lets the right moment arrive without a struggle.
summary: Nia wants to drag the little skiff down to the water at once, but the tide is still out, so she waits and watches until the sea comes up and lifts the boat gently.
